from_plans.name: Dar es Salaam Coast Plots (pre-app)
from_plans.note: Treegens field-team plot — 6,400 trees claimed since 2024, last AI count 413 on plot 01. Filmed evidence, not app-verified.

from_plans.name: Kibugumo Coast Plots (pre-app)
from_plans.note: Treegens field-team plot — 192,630 trees claimed. The largest claim in the corpus, resting on filmed evidence only.

from_place.name: Fund the verified record first
from_place.note: 45 app-verified Mji Mwema records are the only payout-grade evidence here — direct any priced support at them.

from_place.name: Clear the verification backlog
from_place.note: 38 pending records including every Kunduchi claim — reviewers before money.

from_place.name: Extend planting to Kunduchi
from_place.note: Three records show the programme already reached Kinondoni — the next planting days can be upstream.

sips.title: Verification is the bottleneck, not planting
sips.what_changes: 38 pending records nearly equal the 45 verified ones. Each verified record unlocks evidence-grade support; the backlog is the leverage point.

sips.title: The 192,630-tree claim needs its proof
sips.what_changes: Kibugumo's archive figure dwarfs everything else in the corpus — and it is filmed, not app-verified. Re-shooting it would re-grade the whole place's evidence.
